newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Centaur says to raise A$64 million.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Centaur says to raise A$64 million.

text.p: Centaur Mining and Exploration Ltd said on Tuesday it planned to issue 40 million shares at A$1.60 a share to raise A$64 million.

Centaur, part of mining entrepreneur Joseph Gutnick's stable of companies, said the funds would be used for the development of its Cawse nickel project in Western Australia and other working capital needs.
The placement had been arranged by Bell Securities Ltd, which would receive a four percent commission, Centaur said.
The Cawse project has a 193 million tonnes of ore at 0.7 percent nickel and 0.04 percent cobalt.
Centaur shareholders last September approved the placement of 80 million shares at A$$1.70 a share to raise A$136 million.
Centaur shares were one cent lower at A$1.65 at 12.40 p.m. (0240 GMT).
